import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianFiberEpi
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GrassmannianZariskiSheaf

/-!
# Detection of module epimorphisms on affine and field tests

Affine-local detection and Nakayama supply the finite-presentation criterion
for descending generation of the twisted Cartier kernel from field tests.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Pullback along a scheme isomorphism reflects epimorphisms. -/
theorem epi_of_pullback_iso {X Y : Scheme} (e : Y ≅ X)
    {M N : X.Modules} (q : M ⟶ N)
    (hq : Epi ((pullback e.hom).map q)) : Epi q := by
  letI := hq
  let F := pullback e.hom ⋙ pullback e.inv
  let a : F ≅ 𝟭 X.Modules :=
    pullbackComp e.inv e.hom ≪≫ pullbackCongr e.inv_hom_id ≪≫ pullbackId X
  haveI : Epi (F.map q) := by
    change Epi ((pullback e.inv).map ((pullback e.hom).map q))
    infer_instance
  exact epi_of_epi_fac (a.hom.naturality q).symm

/-- Module epimorphy can be tested after every affine-valued pullback. -/
theorem epi_of_affine_pullbacks {X : Scheme.{0}} {M N : X.Modules}
    (q : M ⟶ N)
    (hq : ∀ (R : CommRingCat) (f : Spec R ⟶ X),
      Epi ((pullback f).map q)) : Epi q := by
  let V : X.affineOpens → X.Opens := fun U => U.1
  have hV : TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover V := by
    refine TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover.mk ?_
    apply top_le_iff.mp
    intro x _
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, _⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
      (Scheme.isBasis_affineOpens X) (show x ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨U, hU⟩, hxU⟩
  apply epi_of_cover_epi hV q
  intro U
  letI : IsAffine U.1.toScheme := U.2
  let e := U.1.toScheme.isoSpec
  apply epi_of_pullback_iso e.symm
  let a := pullbackComp e.inv U.1.ι
  haveI : Epi ((pullback (e.inv ≫ U.1.ι)).map q) := hq _ _
  have h : Epi (a.hom.app M ≫ (pullback (e.inv ≫ U.1.ι)).map q) := inferInstance
  rw [← a.hom.naturality q] at h
  exact (epi_comp_iff_of_isIso _ (a.hom.app N)).mp h

/-- A map with quasi-coherent source and finitely presented target is
epimorphic if all of its field-valued pullbacks are epimorphic.  The proof
uses finite sections and residue-field Nakayama on each affine test. -/
theorem epi_of_field_pullbacks_of_isFinitePresentation
    {X : Scheme.{0}} {M N : X.Modules}
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsFinitePresentation] (q : M ⟶ N)
    (hq : ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] (f : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ X),
      Epi ((pullback f).map q)) : Epi q := by
  apply epi_of_affine_pullbacks q
  intro R f
  haveI : ((pullback f).obj M).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom f M inferInstance
  haveI : ((pullback f).obj N).IsFinitePresentation :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation f N inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(Spec R, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
      Γ((pullback f).obj N, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens)) :=
    module_finite_sections_of_isFinitePresentation _ ⟨_, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  apply epi_of_residueField_pullbacks_of_finite ((pullback f).map q)
  intro t
  let g := (Spec R).fromSpecResidueField t
  let a := pullbackComp g f
  haveI : Epi ((pullback (g ≫ f)).map q) := hq ((Spec R).residueField t) (g ≫ f)
  have h : Epi (a.hom.app M ≫ (pullback (g ≫ f)).map q) := inferInstance
  rw [← a.hom.naturality q] at h
  exact (epi_comp_iff_of_isIso _ (a.hom.app N)).mp h

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Algebraically closed field-valued pullbacks suffice for epimorphy of a
map with finitely presented target.  Passing to an algebraic closure and
faithfully flat reflection recover the other field tests. -/
theorem epi_of_geometric_field_pullbacks_of_isFinitePresentation
    {X : Scheme.{0}} {M N : X.Modules}
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsFinitePresentation] (q : M ⟶ N)
    (hq : ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
      (f : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ X),
      Epi ((pullback f).map q)) : Epi q := by
  have hfield : ∀ (K : Type) [Field K]
      (f : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ X),
      Epi ((pullback f).map q) := by
    intro K _ f
    let M' := (pullback f).obj M
    let N' := (pullback f).obj N
    let q' : M' ⟶ N' := (pullback f).map q
    haveI : M'.IsQuasicoherent := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom f M inferInstance
    haveI : N'.IsFinitePresentation := pullback_isFinitePresentation f N inferInstance
    apply epi_of_globalSections_surjective q'
    change Function.Surjective (q'.val.app (.op (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Opens))).hom
    let Kbar := AlgebraicClosure K
    let g : Spec (CommRingCat.of Kbar) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Kbar))
    let a := pullbackComp g f
    haveI : Epi ((pullback (g ≫ f)).map q) := hq Kbar (g ≫ f)
    have hcomp : Epi (a.hom.app M ≫ ((pullback (g ≫ f)).map q)) := inferInstance
    rw [← a.hom.naturality q] at hcomp
    haveI : Epi ((pullback g).map q') :=
      (epi_comp_iff_of_isIso _ (a.hom.app N)).mp hcomp
    have hs : Function.Surjective
        (Hom.app ((pullback g).map q') (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of Kbar)).Opens)).hom :=
      Modules.appTop_surjective_of_epi_over_field ((pullback g).map q')
    letI : Algebra Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤)
        Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of Kbar), ⊤) :=
      (g.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top).hom.toAlgebra
    have hbase : Function.Surjective
        ((show Γ(M', (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Opens)) →ₗ[
            Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Opens))]
            Γ(N', (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Opens)) from
          (q'.val.app (.op (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Opens))).hom).baseChange
          Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of Kbar), (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of Kbar)).Opens))) := by
      exact (baseChange_surjective_iff_pullback_appTop g q').mpr hs
    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor] at hbase
    letI : Field Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤) :=
      ((ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.toMulEquiv.isField
        (Field.toIsField K)).toField
    letI : Field Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of Kbar), ⊤) :=
      ((ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Kbar)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.toMulEquiv.isField
        (Field.toIsField Kbar)).toField
    letI : Module.Free Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤)
        Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of Kbar), ⊤) := Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
    letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤)
        Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of Kbar), ⊤) :=
      Module.FaithfullyFlat.instOfNontrivialOfFree _ _
    exact (Module.FaithfullyFlat.lTensor_surjective_iff_surjective
      Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤) Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of Kbar), ⊤) _).mp hbase
  exact epi_of_field_pullbacks_of_isFinitePresentation q hfield

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
